title: Type conversions
hints: `weightKg / heightCm` does not compile: `float64` and `int` are different types. Convert with `float64(heightCm)`.
Compute the height in metres in a variable first: `m := float64(heightCm) / 100`, then `weightKg / (m * m)`.
`Truncate` is just `return int(f)`. `Pixels` multiplies in `float64` and converts the result: `int(inches * float64(dpi))`.
